correctness.rationale: PASS: Each component of an induced spanning forest in complete bipartite K_{a,b} that has all odd degrees must be K_{1,j} with j positive odd; a component with >=2 vertices in both shores creates an induced C4. The connected two-sort labelled species is x sinh(y)+y sinh(x)-xy, subtracting one double count of K2. Exponential formula yields C_{a,b}(t), and |E|=a+b-components yields the edge enumerator. Every component uses odd positive numbers from both shores, so c<=a (for a<=b) and c≡a≡b (mod 2); c=1 only if a=1, else min 2/3 according to parity. Construct c stars with one opposite-shore center and distribute remaining b-1 vertices to c-1 centers in odd positive blocks. Independent exact enumeration via unlabeled set partitions into induced odd stars gives K2,6 c2=32, K4,4 c4=24/c2=16, K5,5 c5=120/c3=400, K3,3 c3=6. These finite checks support, but do not replace, the species proof.
